rounding_convention: decimal.Decimal only, no floats; ROUND_HALF_UP to whole cents applied per period/per computed amount. Interest accrued on a months/12 basis (face x 9% x months/12). Bonds bought at par, so amortized cost = face throughout; no discount/premium amortization and no PV table factors needed.

notes: LO 14-7 (Appendix 14A) period-end-only variant. Accrued interest paid to the seller on 11/1/Y1 (4 months, Jul 1 bond date to Nov 1) is debited to Interest Receivable, not to the investment, so amortized cost stays at par $60,000. The 12/31/Y1 coupon of $2,700 (6 months) clears that $1,800 receivable and records only the $900 earned (2 months). No FVA entry is made on the 3/15/Y2 sale date: the loss is proceeds $57,600 less amortized cost $60,000. The stale $3,000 credit FVA balance is swept out on 12/31/Y2 because no TS remain. Year 2 has no interest revenue (next coupon was 6/30/Y2 and the stem directs that March accrued interest be ignored).
